settings_yaml:
curation:
  accepted_chembl_validity_comments:
  - ''
  - Manually validated
  canonicalize_tautomers: false
  core_endpoints:
  - IC50
  - Ki
  - Kd
  - EC50
  exact_policy: strict_exact
  exclude_assay_variants: true
  herg_stratify_by:
  - endpoint
  - assay_family
  max_within_compound_log_spread: 2.0
  menin_stratify_by:
  - endpoint
  - assay_family
  pubchem_require_menin_relevance: true
  reject_potential_duplicates: true
  require_rdkit: true
  standardize_structures: true
  strip_salts: true
herg:
  blocker_max_nm: 10000.0
  nonblocker_min_nm: 30000.0
  primary_assay_family: electrophysiology_functional
  primary_endpoint: IC50
  run_pooled_sensitivity: true
modeling:
  analyze_all_eligible_endpoint_assay_tasks: true
  applicability_domain_quantile: 0.05
  bootstrap_iterations: 500
  cv_folds: 3
  evaluation_splits:
  - scaffold
  - chemical
  - temporal
  - random
  feature_backend: rdkit
  fingerprint_bits: 2048
  fingerprint_radius: 2
  menin_endpoints:
  - IC50
  - Ki
  - Kd
  - EC50
  menin_task_assay_families:
    EC50: cellular_functional
    IC50: biochemical_binding
    Kd: biochemical_binding
    Ki: biochemical_binding
  min_classification_compounds: 120
  min_regression_compounds: 80
  primary_menin_assay_family: biochemical_binding
  primary_menin_endpoint: IC50
  primary_split: scaffold
  run_clean_label_sensitivity: true
  run_cross_source_mirror_sensitivity: true
  test_size: 0.2
  tree_estimators: 200
  uncertainty_coverage: 0.9
paths:
  models: models/smoke
  processed: data/processed
  raw: data/raw
  reports: reports/smoke
project:
  name: menin-discovery
  random_state: 13
